title: STEERING IN THE SHADOWS: CAUSAL AMPLIFICATION FOR ACTIVATION SPACE ATTACKS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a dataset of user prompts expressing specific opinions, incorrect statements, or political/demographic personas, measuring whether activation steering causes the model to generate sycophantic responses that flatter or agree with the user instead of remaining objective and truthful.

Evaluated using the custom 'Beshift' dataset to measure gradual semantic and attitudinal drift, observing whether injected activation perturbations cause the model to shift from objective or positive framing to highly critical, skeptical, and negative sentiment when reviewing creative works.
